t: You're on Queensway, a busy shopping street in Bayswater, west London. It's lined with restaurants, cafés, pubs, souvenir shops and a few high-street chains, and it's home to Whiteleys. It's counted as one of Greater London's thirty-five major centres, and right now it's in the middle of big redevelopment on all sides. The name comes from Queen Victoria, who reigned from 1837 to 1901, longer than any monarch before her. Her reign gave its name to the Victorian era, and here her title is stamped on an everyday street.
